idf_component_register(
    SRCS "app_main.c" "air_mouse.c" "ble_mouse.c" "voice.c" "provision.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    PRIV_REQUIRES
        esp_driver_gpio
        esp_driver_i2c
        esp_driver_i2s
        esp_driver_usb_serial_jtag
        esp_timer
        esp_event
        esp_hid
        bt
        nvs_flash
        esp_wifi
        esp_netif
        esp_https_server
        esp_http_server
        mbedtls
        spi_flash
        esp_hw_support
        esp_codec_dev
    REQUIRES board
)

# Per-checkout TLS certificate, private key and pairing token. They are
# generated by windows/Setup-Dev.ps1 (or on first firmware build) into
# windows/.local and embedded into the image so the board and the PC share
# exactly the same trust material.
set(AIRREMOTE_LOCAL "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../windows/.local")
foreach (asset server.crt server.key pairing.txt)
    if (NOT EXISTS "${AIRREMOTE_LOCAL}/${asset}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Missing ${AIRREMOTE_LOCAL}/${asset}. "
            "Run windows/Setup-Dev.ps1 (or firmware/Build.ps1, which prepares it) first.")
    endif()
endforeach()
target_add_binary_data(${COMPONENT_LIB} "${AIRREMOTE_LOCAL}/server.crt" TEXT)
target_add_binary_data(${COMPONENT_LIB} "${AIRREMOTE_LOCAL}/server.key" TEXT)
target_add_binary_data(${COMPONENT_LIB} "${AIRREMOTE_LOCAL}/pairing.txt" TEXT)
